title: wgsextract.methylation-regions-hp/1
description: One typed row of methylation regions --partition-hp. Nulls are empty fields in TSV; the same column names are used in Parquet.

region.description: Gene symbol or CpG island identifier.

transcript.description: Selected RefSeq accession or GFF transcript ID for promoters.

status.description: Assessed, or reason methylation could not be assessed.

expected_cpgs.description: Reference CpG C anchors in the region.

observed_cpgs.description: CpGs with at least one valid call.

qualified_fraction.description: Fraction of expected CpGs that qualify.

observed_valid_calls.description: Valid calls at all observed CpGs.

median_valid_depth.description: Median valid calls per qualifying CpG.

pooled_percent.description: Percent modified, weighting CpGs by depth.

mean_percent.description: Unweighted mean percent across qualifying CpGs.

median_percent.description: Unweighted median percent across qualifying CpGs.

phase_status.description: Evidence for interpreting HP labels within the region.

phase_set.description: Verified PS, when there is a single coherent set.

shared_qualified_cpgs.description: CpGs qualifying in both HP groups, on the combined row.

hp1_minus_hp2_pp.description: HP1 minus HP2 pooled percent on jointly qualifying CpGs in one phase set, on the combined row.
